safeForTelemetry.description: Telemetry-obfuscation policy for this server's tools.

tools.description: Tools to include. Defaults to all tools if not specified.

isDefaultServer.description: Whether this server is a built-in fallback used when the user has not configured their own server.

filterMapping.description: Content filtering mode to apply to all tools, or a map of tool name to content filtering mode.

timeout.description: Timeout in milliseconds for tool discovery and tool calls.

slowConnectionThresholdMs.description: Milliseconds this server may spend connecting before the CLI warns that it is taking longer than expected. Presentation only: it does not change how long the connection is allowed to take.

oidc.description: Set to `true` to use defaults, or provide an object with additional auth or OIDC settings.

auth.description: Set to `true` to use defaults, or provide an object with additional auth or OIDC settings.

deferTools.description: Controls if tools provided by this server can be loaded on demand via tool search (auto) or always included in the initial tool list (never)

disableToolCache.description: Set to true to disable persisted MCP tool snapshots for this server. Live tool discovery is unaffected.

disableSecretMasking.description: Whether secret masking is disabled for calls to this server.

excludeTools.description: Tool names excluded after the include filter is applied.

events.description: Event types this server receives as Copilot notifications.

notifications.description: Copilot notification types this server may send to the host.

source.description: The origin of this server configuration.

sourcePluginVersion.description: Version of the plugin that provided this server.

sourcePluginSpec.description: Whether the providing plugin uses the Open Plugin Spec.

sourcePath.description: Source file path recorded while loading the config.

configWarnings.description: Configuration warnings recorded while loading the server.

command.description: Executable command used to start the Stdio MCP server process.

args.description: Command-line arguments passed to the Stdio MCP server process.

cwd.description: Working directory for the Stdio MCP server process.

env.description: Environment variables to pass to the Stdio MCP server process.

type.description: Local transport type. Defaults to stdio when omitted.

McpServerConfigStdio.description: Stdio MCP server configuration launched as a child process.
McpServerConfigStdio.title: McpServerConfigStdio

version.description: Schema version number for the session event format

producer.description: Identifier of the software producing the events (e.g., "copilot-agent")

copilotVersion.description: Version string of the Copilot application

startTime.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the session was created

selectedModel.description: Model selected at session creation time, if any

reasoningEffort.description: Reasoning effort level used for model calls, if applicable (e.g. "none", "low", "medium", "high", "xhigh", "max")

reasoningSummary.description: Reasoning summary mode used for model calls, if applicable (e.g. "none", "concise", "detailed")

verbosity.description: Output verbosity level used for model calls, if applicable (e.g. "low", "medium", "high")

contextTier.description: Context tier selected at session creation time for models with tiered context pricing; null when no tier is selected (e.g., non-tiered model)

autoTier.description: Auto routing preference selected at session creation time

sessionLimits.description: Session limits configured at session creation time, if any

context.description: Working directory and git context at session start

githubMcpToolConfig.description: Per-session GitHub MCP override persisted for cold resume

alreadyInUse.description: Whether the session was already in use by another client at start time

remoteSteerable.description: Whether this session supports remote steering via GitHub

detachedFromSpawningParentSessionId.description: When set, identifies a parent session whose context this session continues — e.g., a detached headless rem-agent run launched on the parent's interactive shutdown. Telemetry from this session is reported under the parent's session_id.

StartData.description: Session initialization metadata including context and configuration
StartData.title: StartData

resumeTime.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the session was resumed

eventCount.description: Total number of persisted events in the session at the time of resume

eventsFileSizeBytes.description: On-disk byte size of the session's persisted events.jsonl file at resume time; omitted when the file does not exist or cannot be stat'd

selectedModel.description: Model currently selected at resume time

reasoningEffort.description: Reasoning effort level used for model calls, if applicable (e.g. "none", "low", "medium", "high", "xhigh", "max")

reasoningSummary.description: Reasoning summary mode used for model calls, if applicable (e.g. "none", "concise", "detailed")

verbosity.description: Output verbosity level used for model calls, if applicable (e.g. "low", "medium", "high")

contextTier.description: Context tier currently selected at resume time; null when no tier is active

autoTier.description: Auto routing preference active at resume time

sessionLimits.description: Session limits currently configured at resume time; null when no limits are active

context.description: Updated working directory and git context at resume time

alreadyInUse.description: Whether the session was already in use by another client at resume time

sessionWasActive.description: True when this resume passively joined a session that already had live work running in the runtime - an agent turn, a native queue run, a queued resume continuation, or an in-flight send (for example, an extension joining a session another client was actively driving). False (or omitted) when the session had no live work or when the resume explicitly abandoned pending work, including cold resumes and suspended sessions that remain resident in memory.

remoteSteerable.description: Whether this session supports remote steering via GitHub

continuePendingWork.description: When true, tool calls and permission requests left in flight by the previous session lifetime remain pending after resume and the agentic loop awaits their results. User sends are queued behind the pending work until all such requests reach a terminal state. When false or omitted, pending work is normally marked as interrupted unless the resume passively joined live work owned by another client; sessionWasActive distinguishes that case.

ResumeData.description: Session resume metadata including current context and event count
ResumeData.title: ResumeData

toolCallId.description: Unique identifier for this tool call

toolName.description: Name of the tool being executed

toolTitle.description: Human-readable display title for the tool, when the selected tool descriptor has a non-empty title.

shellToolInfo.description: Shell-tool path hints derived from the command at start time for shell tools (bash/powershell/local_shell). Produced by the same shell-aware extractor as PermissionRequestShell.possiblePaths, so it is present even when the command is auto-approved and no permission request fires. Absent for non-shell tools.

model.description: Model identifier that generated this tool call

rte.description: Per-request treatment/eligibility signal returned by the Copilot API in the `X-GitHub-Copilot-Request-TE` response header for the associated model call; `false` when the header was absent or unparseable.

mcpServerName.description: Name of the MCP server hosting this tool, when the tool is an MCP tool

mcpConfigServerName.description: Preferred lookup name for the MCP server hosting this tool: the configured (namespaced) config-map key when the tool carries one, otherwise the display name from `mcpServerName`. Present when the tool is an MCP tool; this is the name unrestricted provenance telemetry hashes so it joins with `mcp_server_setup`, which keys off the configured name too.

mcpToolName.description: Original tool name on the MCP server, when the tool is an MCP tool

mcpTransport.description: Transport the MCP server hosting this tool is connected over, when the tool is an MCP tool and the server is configured

mcpConfigSource.description: Where the MCP server's configuration came from (`user`, `workspace`, `plugin`, or `builtin`), when the tool is an MCP tool and the server is configured

turnId.description: Identifier for the agent loop turn this tool was invoked in, matching the corresponding assistant.turn_start event

displayVerbatim.description: When true, the tool output should be displayed expanded (verbatim) in the CLI timeline

toolDescription.description: Tool definition metadata, present for MCP tools with MCP Apps support

parentToolCallId.description: Tool call ID of the parent tool invocation when this event originates from a sub-agent

fusion.description: Experimental HydraFusion attribution for this tool execution.

ToolExecutionStartData.description: Tool execution startup details including MCP server information when applicable
ToolExecutionStartData.title: ToolExecutionStartData

toolCallId.description: Unique identifier for the completed tool call

success.description: Whether the tool execution completed successfully

model.description: Model identifier that generated this tool call

mcpMeta.description: FIDES IFC label projected from tool ingress metadata (MCP `CallToolResult._meta` or synthesized built-in ingress labels). Persisted as `{ ifc: ... }` so the label survives session resume, including model-visible failure results. Experimental.

interactionId.description: CAPI interaction ID for correlating this tool execution with upstream telemetry

rte.description: Per-request treatment/eligibility signal returned by the Copilot API in the `X-GitHub-Copilot-Request-TE` response header for the associated model call; `false` when the header was absent or unparseable.

isUserRequested.description: Whether this tool call was explicitly requested by the user rather than the assistant

error.description: Error details when the tool execution failed

toolTelemetry.description: Tool-specific telemetry data (e.g., CodeQL check counts, grep match counts)

turnId.description: Identifier for the agent loop turn this tool was invoked in, matching the corresponding assistant.turn_start event

toolDescription.description: Tool definition metadata, present for MCP tools with MCP Apps support

sandboxed.description: Whether this tool execution ran inside a sandbox container

shellExecution.description: Experimental shell completion facts captured before the persisted result contents are stripped.

parentToolCallId.description: Tool call ID of the parent tool invocation when this event originates from a sub-agent

fusion.description: Experimental HydraFusion attribution for this tool completion.

ToolExecutionCompleteData.description: Tool execution completion results including success status, detailed output, and error information
ToolExecutionCompleteData.title: ToolExecutionCompleteData
